reviews.summary: The live site shows the pre-release labels, the Latest stable line, and consistent prerelease counts (68 of 143) in today.json. Existing data and footer are intact.

The mcp/ deliverable is repo-only code, and a stdio server cannot be run through team-fetch, so no acceptance criterion could be observed. The site is up and shows 141 releases, which matches the claimed count, but its build commit (25a9b3c) differs from the expected f16fc07.

The live today.json carries an integer counts object that matches build.json (141/93/14) and the actual item and flagged counts. llms.txt describes it and the footer disclosure and build line are intact.

The deliverable is repo code under mcp/. It is not served publicly, so I could not run or read it. The site is healthy and today.json reports 141 releases, matching the implementer's number. To make this observable, give a reviewer a repo checkout or a public URL for mcp/, such as a GitHub link.

The MCP server is in the repo only and is not served on the public site, so I couldn't check the server, README or tests. The live site is healthy and shows 141 releases, but its build marker (25a9b3c) differs from the expected commit.

The deliverables (mcp/test_conformance.py, server.py fixes, README Conformance section) are not served by the public site, so none of the acceptance criteria could be checked. The live site reports build 25a9b3c, not the expected cf1ca83, and the live pages and JSON appear intact.

I could not verify the release. The criteria concern repository files under mcp/ and a local stdio test, and none of those are served publicly. The live build marker is 25a9b3c, not the expected cf1ca83.

The change lives only in the repository under mcp/, and team-fetch blocked github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com, so I could not read the test, server or README. The live site builds without errors, but nothing observable there confirms or refutes the acceptance criteria.

The live feed now has 161 items, equal to counts.releases of 161 in today.json and build.json, so the cap is gone (option a). Feed structure, item fields and the home-page footer disclosure are intact.

The live site shows the tailwindcss 4.3.4 'kills them' quote gone, with the release still flagged by other lines. Hono is still flagged with its app.mount() quote, and build.json has errors [] and flagged 16, matching today.json.

The live llms.txt lists an index.json URL on every package line, next to the unchanged HTML link. The first three JSON URLs return 200 as JSON, the package count matches today.json (93), and the content type and footer disclosure are intact.
All three acceptance criteria are met on the live site. The /brand/ page shows both variants, the chosen one with a reason, and the channel list, and the footer with the AI disclosure is intact.

The Safari "versions that no longer support" quote is gone from the tailwindcss page, and 4.3.4 is still flagged with other quotes. The hono app.mount() flag remains, build.json is clean, and flagged is 16 in both build.json and today.json. The added stop-list pattern is narrow.

The home page has a Tracked packages (93) section at about 1.4% of the HTML. It lists 44 npm and 49 PyPI links, which matches counts.packages, and both the tailwindcss and typer pages return 200. The footer disclosure and build line are present, and the release lists and JSON are intact.

The home page matches the task: plain lead, collapsed 'Find your package (93)' details, and the first card right after it. The regex explanation now sits below the cards. The footer disclosure and build line are present.

The previous-edit quote is gone from the tailwindcss page. Tailwind 4.3.4 is still flagged through other quotes, hono's mount() flag is intact, and build.json shows flagged 16 with errors [], matching today.json. The new pattern is narrow and leaves the regex alone.

The tailwindcss 4.3.4 false flag is gone. Hono 4.13.16 is still flagged, and build.json (errors [], flagged 12) matches today.json counts.flagged (12). The stop-list pattern is narrow, so unsupported/accepts/drops wording is unaffected.

po_digest_md:
**Release Radar — цикл 03.11, 23:07 UTC**

**Что произошло.** Приняты все задачи дня:
- стоп-лист ложных флагов: T-0019, T-0024, T-0032, T-0042;
- индекс пакетов и новый первый экран главной: T-0025, T-0028;
- аватар: T-0021;
- маркетинговый план недели: T-0023;
- первые посты в Mastodon, X и Threads.

Персоны прогнали 9 сценариев, 6 из них успешны (hono, typer, mcp/Errata, 404 для неотслеживаемого пакета). По метрикам за 03.11 — 54 человека, из них 19 engaged. Из каналов больше всего людей пока у Bluesky (5 источников), у Mastodon 3, у Threads 2. У Telegram и X пока 0, судить рано.

**Решения.**
- Нарезаны два следующих слота плана на 09.11 07:30: Telegram (T-0045) и Bluesky (T-0046). Слоты на 09.11 для X, Threads и dev.to нарежу в следующих циклах.
- Цитаты вида «no longer validate…» отложены: они уже вышли из 7-дневного окна. Широкое правило по «no longer» спрятало бы и настоящие удаления.
- Трудности персон (нет вида на несколько пакетов сразу, пре-релизы в счётчиках) уже закрыты T-0028 и T-0008. Вставка package.json потребовала бы форму или JS — запрещено VISION.
- Новых задач разработчику нет.

**От владельца ничего не нужно.**

**Расходы.** $15.48 из $20 (77 %). Новые задачи — только посты с отложенным стартом, сегодня они не запускаются.
